Sound diagnostics—

If you hear a stuck tone: turn sound on, start the idle or a pull, then solo layers until it disappears. The readout shows the loudest frequency the mix is producing right now.

Career dev mode

A cheat switch for this save only. The HUD says DEV while it is on; contracts and certs still work normally so you can test the whole loop.

Frame-rate cap

iPhone and iPad browsers hold web pages to 60 fps unless Settings › Apps › Safari › Advanced › Feature Flags › ‘Prefer Page Rendering Updates near 60fps’ is turned off.

Saves autosave on

Autosave keeps your current game on this device. Slots are manual snapshots — save before a risky build, load to roll back. A save code moves everything to another phone.
